title: Passive to Active Voice: Practice — Quiz 114
content:
## Passive to Active Voice: Practice

Put the agent back into the subject position in active voice.

### Lesson focus

1. Social distancing needs to be maintained (by you).
2. Subodh Kumar Jaiswal was appointed CBI director on Tuesday (by the govt).
3. Doctors say that mucormycosis or black fungus may also be caused by the overuse of antibiotics, zinc supplements and iron tablets.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
